meta.name: false-green-tests
meta.description: Find out why the tests pass but the app is broken. Catches false greens: a green suite over a feature that does not work, a mocked API standing in for a real one, an assertion that holds no matter what the app does, a click handler wired to nothing. Use when the suite is green and the user says it is broken, when a test never fails, when coverage looks fine but bugs still ship, or before trusting a passing run you did not watch.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 揪出测试全绿却功能失效的假通过,让绿灯真正可信
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果测试全都通过,但实际功能却坏掉了。
copy.tagline_en: Catch false greens so a passing suite actually means working software
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your tests pass but the feature still does not work.

howto.what: Claude 会运行真实应用,把应用实际做的事和测试声称的事对比,找出「测试全绿但功能没生效」的假绿灯:永远不会失败的断言、用 mock 顶替真 API、界面显示与状态不一致等,并改写漏掉问题的测试。
howto.when: 当测试全部通过但你说应用坏了、某个测试从来没失败过、或覆盖率看着正常却仍出 bug 时触发。

say.text: 测试全过了但按钮点了没反应,帮我查为什么
say.note: 它会真实点击并观察请求与状态

say.text: 这个测试从来没失败过,看看断言是不是空的
say.note: 会核对断言是否只验证「没有报错」

say.text: 跑一遍爬取,看哪些界面从没被测过
say.note: 返回未被操作的控件清单

howto.what_en: Claude runs the real app and compares what it does against what the tests claim, catching false greens: assertions that cannot fail, mocks standing in for real APIs, UI state mismatch. It then rewrites the test that missed it.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the suite is green but you say the app is broken, when a test never fails, or when coverage looks fine yet bugs still ship.

say_en.text: The suite passes but clicking the button does nothing - find out why
say_en.note: It clicks for real and watches requests and state

say_en.text: This test has never failed; check whether its assertion is empty
say_en.note: Checks if it only asserts nothing errored

say_en.text: Run a crawl to see which surfaces were never exercised
